applicability: Checking scaffold-constrained planar stance before remaining root degrees of freedom are released
Checking sign-controlled pitch disturbance recovery and reasoned support-loss stopping
claim: In the exact certified BR7.3 fixture, two ordinary distal contacts and four paired finite joint actuators regulate scaffold-constrained planar height and pitch, reconstruct aggregate support and pitch wrench, recover from the declared positive 0.03 newton-meter-second pitch impulse, and emit one fail-closed stop after declared right-support removal makes the requested pitch moment infeasible.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact BR7.0 two-contact planar allocation, BR7.1 friction and unilateral rejection, BR7.2 support/capture segment and support-loss supervision, and BR7.3 live two-leg planar stance program scopes named by the source-pinned programs; BR7.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The unpowered Generic6DOF out-of-plane guide is an explicit material scaffold: sagittal X/Y translation and pitch are released while out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw remain locked, and all guide motors and springs remain off. Two ordinary distal contacts, four paired finite joint actuators, strict non-clamping allocation, whole-system aggregate support and pitch-wrench reconstruction, the declared positive pitch impulse, and the declared right-support removal retain their exact fixture, geometry, mass, timestep, solver, controller, and actuator scopes. Commanded left/right contact shares are not measured per-foot loads. This establishes scaffold-constrained planar height/pitch stance and support-loss detection only, not free 3D standing, unconstrained balance, per-foot measured load allocation, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared two-leg fixture regulates planar height and pitch through ordinary distal contacts and paired finite torques, reconstructs aggregate support and pitch wrench from whole-system momentum, recovers the declared positive pitch impulse, and emits one fail-closed event after declared right-support removal while retaining the explicit out-of-plane scaffold.

failure_boundaries: The out-of-plane guide is a material scaffold even though all of its motors and springs are disabled
Aggregate support and pitch-wrench reconstruction cannot allocate measured load to either foot
Commanded left and right contact shares are not measurements
No free 3D standing, unconstrained balance, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: A strict planar wrench request is mapped through finite paired joint actuators while whole-system linear and angular momentum reconstruct aggregate external support and pitch wrench. The unpowered guide releases sagittal X/Y translation and pitch but locks out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw.
scope: Only the exact root and link geometry and masses, two ordinary distal contacts, unpowered out-of-plane guide, controller gains, actuator ceiling, positive pitch impulse, right-support removal, timestep, solver, engine, source, and program claim scope certified by br7_20260723T134427Z_91a160b9.
title: The certified two-leg fixture regulates planar height and pitch within an explicit scaffold
